name: DECOMPOSED
description: A theorem-sized import has been split into typed child obligations.

name: DERIVED_WITH_IMPORTED_CHILDREN
description: The parent fact is derived, but at least one load-bearing child remains imported.

name: DERIVED_WITH_SHARED_KERNEL
description: The parent is derived from a reusable provider theorem or foundation kernel.

name: FALSIFIED
description: The claimed inference failed or a counterexample was witnessed.

name: FULLY_INTERNALIZED_FOR_SCOPE
description: All load-bearing inference content is represented above the declared trust boundary for the stated scope.

name: IMPORTED
description: The conclusion is accepted from an external theorem or trusted adapter.

name: NOT_EVALUABLE
description: The rule lacks the data, adapter, or scope information required to evaluate it.

name: PLANNED
description: The theorem or edge has a declared contract but no active proof object yet.

name: SUPERSEDED
description: A historical theorem edge or schema is retained for provenance but is no longer live.
